## Summary

Added Japanese support to the `/login` and `/register` pages using Guren's built-in i18n system:

- **`src/app.ts`**: added `'ja'` to `i18n.supported`, enabling automatic locale detection from `Accept-Language` (with `query`/`cookie` sources also available, per the framework default) and the Japanese fallback-to-English behavior for unsupported languages.
- **`lang/en/auth.json`** (new) and **`lang/ja/auth.json`** (new): the login/register copy moved out of the page components into a new `auth` translation namespace, with identical keys in both locales (`login.title`, `login.heading`, `login.subtitle`, `login.email`, `login.password`, `login.remember`, `login.submit`, `login.noAccount`, `login.signUp`, and the equivalent `register.*` keys), holding the exact English and Japanese strings from the spec.
- **`lang/ja/messages.json`** (new): added the Japanese `welcome` translation (`:nameへようこそ！`), preserving the `:name` placeholder.
- **`resources/js/pages/auth/Login.tsx`** and **`Register.tsx`**: replaced hardcoded English strings with `useTranslation()` (`@guren/inertia-client`) calls against the new `auth.*` keys, including the `<Head title>`.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts`** and **`RegisterController.ts`**: the `title` option passed to `this.inertia(...)` (which sets the server-rendered `<title>` before hydration) now uses `this.t('auth.login.title')` / `this.t('auth.register.title')` instead of static English strings.
- **`.guren/translations.gen.ts`**: regenerated via `bunx guren codegen` (20 typed keys now).
- **`tests/controllers/LoginController.test.ts`** and **`RegisterController.test.ts`** (new): cover the Accept-Language matrix from the spec (no header, Japanese-preferring, English-preferring, English-outranks-Japanese, unsupported-language-only) by asserting the rendered `<title>`, plus a check that the shared `_i18n` Inertia prop carries the correct Japanese `auth.login`/`auth.register` messages.

`bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (14 pass, 0 fail), and `bunx guren check` (catalog key-parity checks included) all pass.
